clinical_summary: Patient reports severe chest tightness with observed chest-clutching posture.
action_needed: Immediate transfer to resuscitation / acute care area for ECG.

soap_note.subjective: Patient complains of crushing chest pressure and dizziness.
soap_note.objective: Vision Module: Persistent chest hold detected (2.3s), normal skin perfusion.
soap_note.assessment: High-risk acute coronary syndrome presentation (ESI Level 2).
soap_note.plan: Alert triage nurse immediately, prepare wheelchair and ECG.
